description: Net proofs: a general safety net fires at a real known-bad commit and stays quiet at its fix. Regression proofs (regression-proofs.json) prove a fix with a ReproRunner repro; net proofs prove that a net not written for the defect detects it. Capabilities are probed on each tree before and after the overlay; a required capability that is missing makes the proof not-applicable, which is never a pass. Maintained by .github/scripts/net_proof.py; see docs/rules/safety-evidence.md#net-proofs.
